title: Idea to Page
summary: Idea = screens + steps — User Flow before colors or code

sections.heading: Orientation — Lesson Start
sections.subtitle: Lesson Start
sections.contentMarkdown:
- What will you understand? Any AI idea you can build as screens + steps — before any code.
- Why now? Phase 3 building starts with a map — not with random colors or features.
- What after the lesson? You will sketch a flow of 3 screens — beginning, middle, end.

sections.heading: Tension — Strong Idea — Blank Page
sections.subtitle: Strong Idea — Blank Page
sections.contentMarkdown:
- You have a great AI idea — but when you open the building tool, you don't know the first step.
- Do you start with colors? Or with the model? Or with the prompt? — and you waste hours.
- The problem is not the tool. The problem is that the idea has not yet been translated into a customer journey.

sections.heading: Core Idea — Idea = Screens + Steps
sections.subtitle: Idea = Screens + Steps
sections.contentMarkdown:
- Any AI application = journey: the customer opens → does something → reaches the goal.
- Each step = screen. 3 screens are enough to start: beginning, middle, end.
- Before colors and code: sketch «how the customer moves».
- User Flow = the map. Screens = the houses on the map.

sections.heading: Glossary — Two Terms to Start
sections.subtitle: Two Terms to Start
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Term | Meaning | Example |
|---------|--------|------|
| User Flow | The steps the customer takes to reach their goal | opens → types a question → gets an answer. 3 steps |
| Screen | Each step in the journey = one screen in the app | Screen 1: input box. Screen 2: AI asks. Screen 3: the result |

sections.heading: Screenshot Block (Intent)
sections.contentMarkdown: Any page = one goal + clear steps. The user enters → sees the map → chooses. The same logic applies to your application.

sections.heading: Quiz — Quick Confirmation
sections.subtitle: Quick Confirmation
sections.contentMarkdown:
Question: You are using AI to plan workouts. What is the most important first step?
Sketch the User Flow: from «setting a goal» to «getting the plan».
Choose the best AI model.
Design the result screen.
Explanation: The journey first — when you know the steps, you know the screens and the questions that AI needs to ask.
bullets: Sketch the User Flow: from «setting a goal» to «getting the plan».

sections.heading: Mission — Sketch a Flow of 3 Screens
sections.subtitle: Sketch a Flow of 3 Screens
sections.contentMarkdown:
Introduction: Planning task — not code. Paper and pen or notes. 5–10 minutes. Delivery: 1. The idea (sentence)
2. 3 screens — for each one: what do they see? what do they do?
3. Arrow between each screen: «after doing X → goes to Y» Evaluation Criteria: | Dimension | Weight | Criteria |
|-------|-------|---------|
| 3 Logical Screens | 60% | Beginning → Middle → End — not random. Each screen has «sees» and «does» |
| Clear Goal | 40% | Screen 3 has a result — not an «open end». The arrows connect the steps |
